example_prompts: Use this as the model: 'Meeting notes - Mon 3 June. Attendees: A, B. Decisions: 1) Budget approved. Actions: A to book room.' Write notes in the same format for our Thursday planning call: we chose the venue and Sam will send invites.
Use this letter as a model and write another one in the same style for a different customer, with these details

Here is last year's bake sale announcement: 'Join us Saturday 10-2 at the town hall for cakes, bread and live music. All proceeds go to the library.' Write one in the same format for our school's book fair.
Make a new copy of my attached spreadsheet with the same layout and formulas, filled with these new rows
